messages:
tye_sales: Dropped SUMMIT pen-test bundle into the secure share per their request. They asked for full evidence + timeline. Link: https://redwood-secure.example/summit/2058887777 :paperclip:
vault_bot: Artifacts saved to s3://redwood-secure/summit/2058887777/
  - report: summit-pt-report.pdf
  - scanner: summit-scan.xml.gz
  - pocs: summit-pocs.tar.gz
  - manifest: summit-manifest.json
  - checksums: summit-2058887777.sha256
nina_se: quick review: a few PoCs include internal hostnames and one service token embedded in logs. Legal will not allow raw binaries or creds. Need to redact before sharing.
ada_eng: I can run the sanitizer tonight. Plan: replace hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, strip tokens, convert any runnable PoC binaries to stepwise pseudo-PoCs and attach MD repro docs. ETA: 2058895000 (tomorrow morning).
sam_ciso: Conditions for release: (1) sanitized bundle only unless customer signs NDA addendum; (2) include CVSS v3 score, attack complexity, priv esc flag in manifest; (3) designate our security liaison for escalation. Proposed SLA: Critical=5 days, High=20 days, Medium=45 days. If customer insists on raw PoCs require controlled access + NDA.
tyse_sales: SUMMIT requested 30 days. I'll push our SLA and offer accelerated remediation for criticals if they accept our proposed timeline and weekly status updates.
marta_pm: Product can ship a temporary config toggle to mitigate one of the high findings (input validation strict mode) in ~4 business days. We can deliver an interim mitigation sooner as a workaround.
nina_se: posted redact script: `scripts/scrub_sensitive_artifacts.sh` — usage: `./scrub_sensitive_artifacts.sh summit-pocs.tar.gz > summit-pocs-sanitized.tar.gz` (removes IPs, replaces hostnames, strips tokens, drops large binaries >5MB).
ada_eng: ran sanitizer, replaced hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, removed tokens and AWS keys, converted binaries to pseudo-PoC markdown with sanitized command snippets. Uploaded sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/summit/2058887777/sanitized/ and updated manifest.
vault_bot: Audit: sanitized bundle published by ada_eng at 2058895100. Link expiry: 21 days. sha256: 2b7c1d... summit-sanitized-2058887777.sha256
sam_ciso: Reviewing sanitized bundle now. If OK I'll approve release under these terms: sanitized artifacts + manifest + CVSS table; require signed SLA acceptance; if SUMMIT wants raw PoCs then NDA addendum + controlled access (jumpbox) required. I can sign the sanitized release after quick pass.
tyse_sales: Great. Also SUMMIT asked whether we can provide repro steps in a runnable VM snapshot under NDA — that's a no-go unless legal signs off and we do time-limited access.
nina_se: attaching one-page Risk Acceptance (RA) template and a short mitigation runbook describing quick workarounds (rate-limit toggle, strict input mode).
marta_pm: opened ticket SM-6173 to track fixes: assigned to eng-auth and validation team. ETA critical fix: 4 business days. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SM-6173
ada_eng: added temporary mitigation in the ticket that we can ship as a config change in 48 hours if prioritized.
tye_sales: I'll draft the email to SUMMIT security: attach sanitized bundle + manifest + CVSS table + proposed SLA and ask if they need raw PoC access under NDA. propose share date: 2058896000 (this afternoon) and initial mitigation deploy by 2058930000 (~2 business days). Full patch target: 2059100000 (~7 business days). Will include weekly status cadence.
sam_ciso: Sounds fine. One more thing: require that if they request binaries under NDA we log access and limit to approved IPs and time windows. If they refuse NDA, do not send raw artifacts.
nina_se: included sanitized repro notes and pseudo-PoC markdown in the bundle so they can triage. Also added a CSV table of CVSS + exploitability for each finding in the manifest.
tyse_sales: Sending now. I'll CC sam_ciso and marta_pm. :thumbsup:
vault_bot: Notification: sanitized bundle shared with summit-security@summit-corp.com (pending acceptance). Audit entry created: 2058896200.
ada_eng: FYI I've added an automated scrub job as an action item to the artifacts pipeline (ENGOPS-198) so future bundles get a scrubbed copy by default.
tyse_sales: SUMMIT replied asking for exact dates. I'll respond with the proposed timeline above and ask if they want a call to go through findings.
sam_ciso: Confirmed. If SUMMIT insists on raw PoCs without NDA, escalate to legal and deny. Otherwise proceed with controlled NDA flow. Approving sanitized release now.
marta_pm: logging follow-up to add explicit scrub + RA template to the standard sales handoff checklist. we'll track in the postmortem.
